name: blockcharts
description: Interactive SVG and canvas charts described as JSON, assembled from independent blocks. For standalone HTML reports and for pages of your own.
author: Alexander Lisin

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run manifest && node scripts/test.js && node scripts/test-canvas.js && node scripts/test-compose.js && node scripts/test-csv.js && node scripts/test-skill.js && node scripts/test-dist.js
scripts.page: npm run build && npm run manifest && node scripts/page.js
scripts.skill: npm run build && npm run manifest && node scripts/build-skill.js
scripts.release: npm run build && npm run manifest && node scripts/build-dist.js
scripts.site: npm run build && npm run manifest && npm --prefix site run build && node scripts/check-site.js
